messages:
alex_sales: quick sync — Customer (FinTechCo) asked for a 3-week POC. Need to confirm scoping, success criteria, and readout plan. Looping in infra, sec, pricing, and CS.

maria_solutions: thanks! can we confirm primary use case: realtime customer support summarization + RAG for policy lookups?

alex_sales: yes — two pipelines: 1) short-form summarization (avg 120 tokens output) 2) RAG retrieval + long answer (avg 800 tokens).

jamal_eng: technical constraints from our side: if they want <200ms 95p on summarize we need dedicated capacity (g4dn equivalent) and batching disabled for latency-critical route. Is that expected?

chris_pricing: dedicated capacity changes pricing. For a 3-week POC we can offer a $X/day reserved dev tier, plus token usage. Need an expected qps to firm up numbers.

nina_customer_success: FinTechCo expects to run ~3000 user summaries/day and 500 RAG queries/day during the POC window. They care about SLA for latency and data isolation.

maria_solutions: success criteria proposal:
- Summarization: 95th percentile latency <= 300ms, quality pass rate >= 90% on our prompt evals
- RAG: correctness (factuality) >= 85% on a 200-sample eval set, end-to-end P99 latency <= 2.5s
- Cost: infer cost per 1k tokens <= $Y (TBD)
- Security: no customer PII leaves their VPC, SSO + SCIM in place, completed security questionnaire

sophia_security: quick note on sec questionnaire: we can answer SOC2 questions, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration. For VPC-hosted Private deployment we need network peering details from their infra team. Also they'll ask about access controls and audit logs — we should surface our retention policy.

alex_sales: timeline suggested:
- Week 0 (this week): kick-off, security Q answered, infra contacts exchanged, pricing term agreed
- Week 1: Private env setup + model onboarding, smoke tests
- Week 2: run evaluation prompts (500 summary prompts, 200 RAG prompts + 50 edge cases), iterate prompts, measure metrics
- Week 3: hard load run (~3k summaries/day), collect final metrics, readout deck prep, exec review

jamal_eng: for the evals we should capture detailed logs: input prompt, model output, model version, latency, token counts. I'll add KV-cache and batching config we used so results are reproducible.

chris_pricing: pricing anchor — I'll draft two scenarios: (A) POC on hosted with burst capacity (per-token billing + small infra surcharge) and (B) Private with a short-term reserved node (flat daily + per-token). Will share numbers by EOD.

nina_customer_success: customer also asked for acceptance criteria for go/no-go decision. Recommend: all must be green except 1 minor gap allowed. If security questionnaire or SSO fails, POC halts.

maria_solutions: readout deliverables: 1) 1-slide executive summary (latency, quality, cost), 2) technical appendix (eval set, prompts, configs), 3) gap analysis & next-steps (dedicated capacity ask, SLA proposal, integration plan)

alex_sales: blockers flagged: 
- security questionnaire answers pending from sophia
- network peering details pending from FinTechCo (nina to collect)
- pricing scenario review (chris)
- infra calendar availability for Private setup (jamal)

sophia_security: I'll push the sec questionnaire draft tonight. For the peering we need their VPC CIDRs, peering window, and whether they'll accept a transit VPC.

nina_customer_success: I'll request peering details and SSO SAML metadata from them after lunch, and confirm run hours for the heavy-load test.

deploy-bot: deployment scheduled: private-env-staging -> node-group-7 at 2024-08-16T14:30:00Z (ticket #POC-421)

jamal_eng: noted on deploy-bot. I blocked time Wed/Thu this week to onboard models and validate kernels. Can someone confirm model family/version they want?

maria_solutions: usecase preference: open-llama-2-13B-quant v1 for cost baseline, and seq2seq-llm-large for higher quality checks. We'll compare outputs side-by-side in evals.

chris_pricing: shared draft pricing in the drive: https://redwood.example/corp/pricing/poc-fintechco (please review)

alex_sales: action items (owner):
- sophia_security: finalize sec questionnaire responses (today)
- nina_customer_success: collect VPC peering + SSO metadata (today)
- chris_pricing: finalize POC pricing scenarios (EOD)
- jamal_eng: reserve infra slots + run smoke deploy (this week)
- maria_solutions: prep eval prompt set (500 summaries, 200 RAG, 50 edge cases) and eval rubric (tomorrow)
- alex_sales: schedule readout meeting with FinTechCo for end of Week 3

alex_sales: ok everyone — if no objections I'll take these as the plan and send the kickoff email to FinTechCo in 30m. :rocket:
